quizName:
Sign Test
									  					
									  														  					Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic flows in both directions ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A lane is ending or the road is narrowing ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A lane is ending or the road is narrowing ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns that the right lane is ending or the road will get narrower.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Highway changes to the right ahead.
Hiking trails to the right ahead.

questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a hospital with emergency services is located to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is approaching.
Look both ways as you cross the intersection.
Come to a complete stop at the intersection.
Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.
questions.explanation: Reduce your speed as you approach a yield sign. Be ready to stop and let other vehicles and pedestrians go first. Stop completely if traffic requires it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the divided highway ends ahead.

questions.question: If you see this sign, you should:

options.text: Keep your current speed until you reach the reduced speed zone.
Start to slow down your vehicle.
Not slow down because traffic will back up.
Slow down only if you choose to.

questions.correctAnswerText: Start to slow down your vehicle.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to begin slowing down. The new speed limit will start at the next speed limit sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic light is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs control how traffic moves and the speed drivers must follow. This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive slowly and honk your horn.
You are entering a school parking lot.

questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn drivers about hazards ahead. This sign tells you a school zone is coming. Slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are entering a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
When turning left on a green light, yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: When turning left on a green light, yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign appears with a traffic signal. It tells drivers turning left on green that they must wait for oncoming traffic to pass first.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Circular signs indicate railroad crossings. This sign warns you that a train crossing is ahead. Watch for trains.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn drivers about hazards ahead. This sign warns you of a sharp turn coming. Reduce your speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn drivers about hazards ahead. This sign alerts you to a curve in the road.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A sharp left turn is ahead.
Follow the detour to avoid unsafe driving conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Follow the detour to avoid unsafe driving conditions.
questions.explanation: These signs show that traffic is being rerouted due to construction or hazards. Follow the marked detour.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic light ahead is red.
The traffic light ahead is broken.
The traffic light ahead is green.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic light is coming at the next intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn drivers about hazards ahead. This sign warns of a steep hill. Slow down to protect your brakes and avoid accidents.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines are doubled in work zones.

questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn drivers about hazards ahead. This sign warns you that overhead clearance is limited ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Construction work is ahead on the highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Construction work is ahead on the highway.
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn of hazards in work zones. This sign tells you construction is ahead. Slow down and drive carefully.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The safest speed in a residential area.
The safest speed when exiting an expressway.
The safest speed when entering an expressway.
The safest speed in a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The safest speed when exiting an expressway.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the safest speed for exiting a highway. In this example, the safe speed is 30 mph.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Yield when turning left on green.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yield when turning left on green.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that when turning left at a green light, they must yield to oncoming traffic. You can complete your turn when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Drive carefully and be ready to stop.

questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop. Wait for vehicles and pedestrians to clear before you go.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are coming.

questions.explanation: This sign shows where bicycles cross or ride. Drive slowly and carefully because bicycles often cross or ride near traffic in this area.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Traffic only goes in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic only goes in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This one-way sign means traffic can only move in the direction shown by the arrow.

questions.question: What must you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Stop completely and look for pedestrians and traffic crossing.
Slow down but do not stop completely.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and look for pedestrians and traffic crossing.
questions.explanation: Any eight-sided sign is a stop sign. You must stop completely. Look for pedestrians and crossing traffic before going through the intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Yield when turning left on green.

questions.explanation: Warning signs alert drivers to hazards ahead. They are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that farm machinery may be driving in the area.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Cars in the right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes of traffic going the same direction will soon become one lane.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means the right lane ends ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign means you cannot turn left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that a T intersection is coming. Be ready to turn left or right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Construction workers on or near the roadway.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on yellow. This sign warns you that people may be crossing the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are entering a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may go if the road is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are entering a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: If you see this sign, you are going the wrong way. You may have a head-on collision. Turn around carefully.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a four-way intersection is coming.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means the road ahead has many curves and turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign alerts you that buggies may be ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Do not park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash means the action is not allowed. This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign tells you the direction you must drive on a one-way street.

questions.question: If you see this sign above your lane, you:

options.text: Can either continue or exit from your current lane.
Can stay in your lane and continue straight.
Must exit the freeway if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must exit the freeway if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign means your lane will leave the freeway. You must exit if you stay in that lane. You can change lanes to continue through the interchange.

questions.question: This sign warns drivers that:

options.text: The right lane ends and you must merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane ends and you must merge left.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the right lane will end. You must move your vehicle to the left lane.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: You may turn right after you stop completely.

questions.explanation: This is a rule sign that you must follow. Right turns are not permitted at this location.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that people may be crossing the road. Watch for pedestrians and be ready to stop.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert you to upcoming hazards. This sign tells you that the divided highway is ending.

questions.question: When you see this black and yellow sign, it means:

options.text: The road to the right is one-way only.
There is a detour to the right because of roadwork.
Slow down because the road turns sharply ahead.
There is a crossroad to your right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down because the road turns sharply ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead makes a sharp turn. You should slow down before reaching this sharp turn.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: A group is picking up trash on the highway ahead.
Workers are on or near the road ahead.
There is a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or near the road ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that workers may be on or very near the roadway. Drive carefully through this area.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you a playground is near. Watch for children on or near the road.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a roundabout is coming. Enter slowly and let traffic already in the roundabout go first.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Two lanes of traffic moving in opposite directions are merging.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that an overpass has low clearance. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height shown.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep downhill grade is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you not to enter. It is posted at the end of one-way streets. It warns drivers not to drive the wrong way. Stop and turn around if you see this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot park here at any time.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Follow a detour to the right.
Get ready to enter a one-way street.
Stay on the main highway if you can.
Follow a detour to the right, but only if it's convenient.

questions.correctAnswerText: Follow a detour to the right.
questions.explanation: Construction signs are orange with black lettering. This detour sign tells you to take an alternate route to avoid a blocked road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This orange construction sign warns you about dangers ahead. A flagger is coming up and will direct traffic. Follow their directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you can park for only two hours. The posted times show when this rule applies.

questions.question: What does this sign warn you about?

options.text: An upcoming curve in the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: An upcoming curve in the road.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road curves to the right ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This orange construction sign warns you. Construction is coming up ahead. Be careful around construction zones.

questions.question: A driver's left arm and hand are extended downward. What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: This hand signal means the driver is going to stop. Watch for this signal and be ready to slow down.

questions.question: This sign shows one type of:
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a road crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What type of sign is this?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black lettering. They warn you about hazards or special situations ahead.

questions.question: From top to bottom, what is the correct order of colors on a traffic light?
questions.explanation: Traffic lights always have red on top and green on the bottom when vertical. When horizontal, red is always on the left and green is always on the right.

questions.question: This sign warns you that you are approaching:
questions.explanation: This sign means a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must not pass another vehicle.
You may pass a slow-moving vehicle if you do it quickly.
You may pass if you know the road ahead.
You may pass, but only at night.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must not pass another vehicle.
questions.explanation: This is a regulatory sign that you must obey. It means passing other vehicles is not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a flagger is ahead controlling traffic in a construction area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells drivers that lanes are shifting. Follow the new lane path ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This warning sign tells drivers the road ahead has curves. You should slow down and be ready for the winding road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that bicycles may be in the area ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This warning sign tells you that a stop sign is coming. Get ready to come to a complete stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn at this location.

questions.question: This sign prevents:

options.text: Entrance from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.

questions.correctAnswerText: Entrance from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic only moves one way. You cannot enter from your current direction.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: A divided highway is starting ahead. The road will split into two separate one-way roads with a divider between them. You must stay on the right side.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns you that traffic may enter the road from a side road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a 35 mph speed zone after the curve ahead.
Drive no less than 35 mph around the curve ahead.
A curve is ahead. Driving 35 mph or slower is recommended.
Stay in the right-hand lane if not driving over 35 mph.

questions.correctAnswerText: A curve is ahead. Driving 35 mph or slower is recommended.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road curves ahead in the direction shown by the arrow. The sign recommends driving at 35 mph or slower through the curve.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road turns sharply right, then left.
The road turns sharply left, then right.
The road curves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead will make a sharp right turn and then a sharp left turn.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Keep to the side shown by the arrow.
You may drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep to the side shown by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This is a "Keep right" sign. It tells you that a traffic island, median, or barrier is ahead. You must stay on the side shown by the arrow.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that there is a sharp right turn in the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers about work zones. This sign tells you that workers may be on or near the road. Drive carefully and watch for construction crews.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers what they must do. It is posted near an intersection to remind you not to block the intersection with your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They prepare you for upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns you that a yield sign is coming. Be ready to stop and let other drivers and pedestrians go first.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers what they must do. Wherever you see this sign, U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you about a steep hill ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign means large trucks are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to slow down.
Do not drive in this lane.
You must stop completely and yield the right-of-way.
Slow down, be ready to stop, and yield the right-of-way if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, be ready to stop, and yield the right-of-way if needed.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign means you must yield. Slow down as you approach the intersection and be ready to stop. Let other vehicles, cyclists, and pedestrians pass safely before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells you that you can turn right or go straight ahead from this lane at the intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells you that you can turn left or go straight ahead from this lane at the intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and prepare you for road hazards ahead. This sign warns you about a bridge with narrow lanes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for people working on or near the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for people working on or near the road.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that workers are on or near the road. Drive carefully in work zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign means the road ahead turns sharply to the right and then sharply to the left.

questions.question: What does a green arrow on a lane control signal mean?

options.text: No traffic is allowed in this lane.
You must merge into this lane.

questions.explanation: A steady green arrow pointing down means you can use the lane it shows.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A series of curves is ahead.
The road will be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road will be slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that the road becomes slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is an object on the roadway.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road is curving sharply to the left.
There is a merge point ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is curving sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: Chevron signs show that the road curves sharply in the direction the arrow points. In this case, the road curves sharply to the left. You may see several chevron signs throughout the curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
Traffic in the lane must turn in the direction of the arrow.
Lanes are reserved for buses and vehicles with a driver and one or more passengers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for people with disabled parking permits.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs warn drivers about construction zones. This sign directs drivers to take a detour when construction changes the normal driving route.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians walking along the road ahead.
Be alert for construction workers on the road.

questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that a pedestrian crossing is ahead. Drive carefully when pedestrians may be present.

questions.question: What can you do from the center lane?
questions.explanation: This lane is for left turns only. You cannot use it to pass other vehicles or drive straight through.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign alerts drivers that bicycles may cross the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign alerts drivers that cattle may cross the road ahead.

questions.question: What should you do at an intersection with a yield sign?

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Yield just to the traffic on the right.
Yield just to the traffic on the left.
Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and let other traffic go first before you enter the intersection or roadway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers about a fire station nearby. Watch for emergency vehicles on the road. Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means no. This sign prohibits U-turns. You cannot turn around where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Five-sided signs mark school areas. A school is near this sign. Watch for children and pedestrians on the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs mean stop. You must stop and yield to other traffic. You can go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. Do not drive in this direction. Turn around and find another way.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This warning sign alerts drivers that deer may cross the road in this area. Yellow signs with black markings warn about upcoming hazards.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped yellow signs warn about hazards ahead. This sign warns of a steep hill. Slow down and prepare to adjust your speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The highway ahead curves only to the right.
The highway ahead turns sharply to the right.
The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
The highway ahead curves to the left and then to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
questions.explanation: This warning sign shows upcoming curves. The road curves right first, then left. Be ready to adjust your steering.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that deer cross this road. Slow down, watch carefully, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot go in this direction. It is not safe. Turn around and take a different route.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are allowed on the narrow bridge ahead.
The bridge ahead has one-way traffic only.
Only one car can use the bridge ahead at a time.
The bridge ahead may be too narrow to pass a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead may be too narrow to pass a truck.
questions.explanation: Warning signs tell drivers about dangerous road conditions ahead. They are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the bridge ahead may be too narrow to safely meet or pass a truck. Drive carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A crossroad is ahead. Watch for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: A crossroad is ahead. Watch for traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that a crossroad is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic in the left lane must turn left.
You can turn left only on a green arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic in the left lane must turn left.
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign tells drivers in the left lane that they must turn left.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is for vehicles with a certain number of people inside.
Certain turns are allowed from certain lanes.
Both lanes must merge smoothly together.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is for vehicles with a certain number of people inside.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane. These lanes are reserved for buses and cars with a driver and one or more passengers, as shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on yellow backgrounds. They alert drivers to dangers ahead. This sign warns that a divided highway is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs get drivers ready for road hazards. They are usually yellow with black markings. This sign tells drivers to watch for people crossing the street.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay to the right of the divider ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive at the same speed as other traffic.
Do not drive faster than 50 miles per hour for the next 50 miles.
Speed limits are enforced for the next 50 miles.
The maximum speed allowed is 50 miles per hour.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum speed allowed is 50 miles per hour.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the fastest speed you are allowed to drive.

questions.question: What is the main danger of this sign?

options.text: Your headlights will point upward because one side of your car is higher than the other.
A tire can be damaged if it drifts onto the shoulder.
Your car may hydroplane if the shoulder has water on it.
You could lose control if a wheel drops onto the lower shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: You could lose control if a wheel drops onto the lower shoulder.
questions.explanation: This sign means the shoulder is lower than the road. If a wheel drops off the road onto the low shoulder, do not hit the brakes hard or turn sharply. This can cause you to lose control of your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs prepare drivers for hazards ahead. They are usually yellow with black markings. This sign tells drivers to stay alert for dangers and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must stop if other cars stop.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn drivers about hazards ahead. This sign tells you a stop sign is coming. Prepare to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Five-sided signs mean a school is nearby. Watch for children and pedestrians. Obey any crossing guard directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs mark construction zones. They warn drivers to be careful. This sign means a flagger is ahead and will direct traffic. Follow their directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows the minimum legal speed. Do not drive slower than this speed.

questions.question: The driver's left arm and hand point upward. What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a driver's left arm points upward, they are signaling a right turn. Adjust your driving if you follow a driver using this signal.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and let trains pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let trains pass.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a railroad crossing ahead. Slow down when approaching tracks. Trains cannot stop for cars, so you must wait for them to pass.

questions.question: What does the posted speed limit show?

options.text: The exact speed at which you must travel to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe speed in good road and weather conditions.
The maximum safe speed in all conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed in good road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: The speed limit is the maximum legal speed for that road in ideal conditions. You may need to drive slower in bad weather or poor road conditions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This warning sign alerts you to a traffic light ahead. Be ready to stop for a red light or yield to cross traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Don't drink if you are going to drive.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This warning sign alerts you that the shoulder ahead is lower than the road.

questions.question: At a school crossing sign, you should:

options.text: Always stop, even if there is no stop sign.
Look for children and be ready to stop.
Always honk when you see children.
Be ready to help children cross the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: You must let pedestrians cross safely. Always watch for people at intersections and when turning.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: You must go either right or left.
A road is joining from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must go either right or left.
